ui.calm: Calm mode (fewer sounds and less movement)
ui.tagline: Spanish for living and working in Spain
ui.reviewEmpty: Anything you get wrong will show up here so you can practise it again. Nothing yet!
ui.goal: When you finish you'll be able to:
ui.examsIntro: Prepare for the exams Spain requires, with information from official sources.
ui.passNatDesc: My application, CCSE exam and DELE A2
ui.passUniDesc: My route, PCE tests and academic writing
ui.draft: Content under review: not yet checked by an accredited teacher or a lawyer.
ui.disclaimer: This app helps you prepare. It does not replace the Instituto Cervantes, UNED, the DGT, the authorities or a lawyer.
ui.unlock: Unlock the pass (test version, no payment)
ui.myCaseDesc: Answer a few questions and we'll tell you what you need.
ui.caseOneYear: I was born in Spain, I'm married to a Spanish person, I'm the widow or widower of a Spanish person, or my father, mother, grandfather or grandmother was Spanish by origin
ui.caseTwoYears: I'm from an Ibero-American country, Andorra, the Philippines, Equatorial Guinea or Portugal, or I'm Sephardic
ui.qHispanic: Are you a national of one of these countries?
ui.qLangCert: Do you already have a DELE A2 or higher, or an official Spanish certificate A2, B1 or B2 (for example, from an Official Language School)?
ui.qEso: Did you study in Spain and pass the ESO (compulsory secondary education)?
ui.qLiteracy: Do you have difficulty reading and writing, or learning difficulties?
ui.needDele: You need to pass the DELE A2
ui.needCcse: You need to pass the CCSE
ui.minorsNoTests: You don't take the tests: certificates from your school are provided instead
ui.dispensaYouCan: You can ask to be exempted from the tests
ui.dispensaFirst: Important: ask for the exemption before applying for nationality
ui.stepHow: How to apply and the fee
ui.ccseDesc: Constitution and society: 25 questions in 45 minutes
ui.groupNeed: To pass you need 30 out of 50 points in each group.
ui.selfAssessHelp: Compare your answer with the example and score yourself honestly (0 to 3).
ui.speakNow: Speak out loud. When you finish, go to the next task.
ui.uniRouteDesc: Answer a few questions and we'll tell you which steps apply to you.
ui.subjectsDesc: Official format, syllabus and guide for each subject
ui.pceMocksDesc: With the official scoring: wrong answers subtract points
ui.academicWritingDesc: Summary, topic and ideas, and argumentative text
ui.noVisaNotice: Passing the PCE does not give you a visa or a residence permit: that is a separate procedure.
ui.otherSubjectsHelp: We have not prepared their sheet yet. Check the format in each official guide.
ui.qOrigin: Where did you finish (or will you finish) secondary school?
ui.originEu: In a European Union country or one with an agreement with Spain
ui.originOther: In another country (outside the EU, no agreement)
ui.qResident: Are you an EU citizen, or do you already live in Spain with a residence permit?
ui.qUniType: Which kind of university do you want to go to?
ui.stepPceOptional: You don't need an access test: the PCE only raise your grade
ui.countryInfo: Information for your country on UNEDasiss
ui.stepEnroll: Apply for a place at university
ui.testMax: Answer {x} at most. If you answer more, only the first {x} count.
ui.testAll: Answer all the ones you know.
ui.guessTip: If you can rule out one option, answering usually pays off even though mistakes subtract (app's calculation).
ui.tooMany: You have answered more than {x}: only the first {x} count.
ui.testScore: points in this part of the exam
ui.wTheme: 2. Topic and two secondary ideas (3–6 lines)
ui.connectorsDesc: Words to order and link your arguments
ui.spellingDesc: Accents, punctuation and grammar: choose the correct sentence
ui.linesNote: In the exam you write by hand. The app estimates lines at about {x} words per line: it is only an approximation.
ui.calcWarning: The formula comes from a university, not from the law. Each university decides which subjects it weights and by how much. Always check your grade with your target university.
ui.pceAccessGrades: PCE grades that count for the access grade:
ui.pceWeighted: Subjects your university weights (see its weighting table):
ui.calcMissing: Enter your secondary-school grade and at least one PCE grade (0 to 10).
ui.calcBelow5: With an access grade below 5 you cannot get into university.
ui.dictationDesc: Listen to a word and write it: the app marks every mistake
ui.dictSentencesDesc: Listen to full sentences and write them
ui.dictationPrompt: Listen and write what you hear
ui.dictNeedsAudio: Dictation needs audio and you have paused it. Turn it on when you can listen.
ui.dictionaryDesc: All the course words, with audio
ui.searchWords: Search in Spanish or your language
ui.okWithHint: Right, with a hint. You'll review it later.
ui.calcInvalid: Check the grades marked in red: write numbers from 0 to 10, for example 7.5.
ui.passDriveDesc: Exchange your licence or take the DGT exam (licence B)
ui.driveCaseDesc: Three questions and we'll tell you what to do
ui.driveTopicsDesc: What you need to know and questions with explanations
ui.driveTopicsHelp: First study each topic with the official facts, then take its test.
ui.driveMockDesc: 30 questions in 30 minutes, like at the DGT
ui.driveMockRules: Pass with {x} mistakes at most. Unanswered questions count as mistakes.
ui.driveFailsEmpty: The questions you get wrong will appear here
ui.driveWordsDesc: Traffic words from the exam, in your language
ui.driveWordsHelp: The exam uses these words. Learn them before doing the tests.
ui.translationNote: Translations are a guide only: the exam uses the Spanish words.
ui.qHasLicense: Do you already have a driving licence from another country?
ui.fromEu: From an EU country, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Norway
ui.fromConvenio: From a country on the agreement list
ui.qObtainedResident: Did you get that licence when you were already living legally in Spain?
ui.stepCanjeVoluntary: Your licence is valid in Spain: exchanging it is optional
ui.step6Months: Warning: your licence is only valid for six months after you become a resident
ui.stepCanjeNoExam: You can exchange it without an exam (car or motorbike)
ui.topic_alcohol: The driver's condition: alcohol and drugs
ui.levelSub: Lessons adapt to your level. You can change it any time in your Profile.
ui.lvl0d: Single words with translation, audio and an example. Step by step.
ui.lvl1d: I can greet and understand simple words. Less repetition, more writing, including sentences.
ui.lvl2d: I can make simple sentences. No introductions: full sentences as dictation and all units open.
ui.lvl3d: Only sentence dictation, no hints, and missing accents count as mistakes.
ui.accentsCount: At your level, accents and ñ count.
ui.voiceSub: Choose how you want to hear Spanish. The voices work offline.
ui.voiceDeviceDesc: The one built into your phone. It depends on the model.
ui.reportCopied: Copied. Paste it in a message to the app team.
ui.factStale: Checked more than {x} days ago: see the official source in case it has changed.
ui.qBranch: Which field do you want to study?
ui.branchSocial: Social sciences or humanities (law, economics, education…)
ui.branchSubjects: PCE subjects in your field according to the official list (plus the common ones). Each university decides which subjects count for each degree: check its website.
